item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"piece_id":"02","ready":false,"issues":["c1 locator supports only the limitation, not the claim that frontier CAD systems produce editable parametric parts and assemblies.","c2 locator does not support the stated two outputs, STEP imports, Fusion procedure, 1060 aluminum, or mass-match result; use focused exact locators for each checked fact.","c4 overstates its cited evidence: the supplied Backflip locator establishes that mass was checked, not that this check is stronger than a visual demo.","c6 is a catch-all claim combining several NVIDIA workflow checks under one marker; split visual-reference checks, physics-property configuration, and simulation/grasp checks into separate focused claims.","c6 omits support for joints, collision geometry, physical properties, and the full Isaac Sim sequence: these require separate segment locators, including s0005, s0007, and s0008 where applicable.","c8 is an inference based only on one publisher, although the policy requires an inference connecting evidence from two producers.","c8’s comparison to an “unqualified simulation ranking” is unsupported by its cited segments; the cited protocol and small-sample caveat do not establish that comparison.","The draft relies on transcript-derived task and attempt counts in c7–c8 without showing that the audio was checked, despite the policy’s warning that automatic transcripts can garble figures.","The synthesis asserts that the Backflip Fusion add-in omitted geometry, but no separate focused claim documents that observation with an exact locator.","The argument’s broad claim that CAD agents can produce editable geometry and execute simulation workflows is not matched by focused claims that establish those two developments under their stated conditions."]}
